name: 华农表
description: SCAU timetable: sign in to read your weekly schedule; Home Screen widgets (small/medium = today's classes, switching to tomorrow once today's are over; large = whole week) and Lock Screen widgets showing the next class.

localizedDescriptions.en: SCAU timetable with Home Screen widgets: small/medium show today's classes and switch to tomorrow after today's are over; large shows the whole week with today framed; Lock Screen widgets show the next class.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 华南农业大学课表：登录教务系统查看每周课表；主屏小组件显示今天的课（今天上完后切到明天）或整周课表，锁屏小组件显示下一节课
